verdict.rationale: Vue's official testing guide recommends @vue/test-utils for component testing and includes mount()-based examples that render a component and interact with it. Vitest, maintained by Vue/Vite team members, serves as the runner. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the test-utils workflow, and detailed first-party coverage of the interaction APIs (events, stubbing for isolation) beyond the guide's summary.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official testing utilities to render and interact with components in isolation

citations.quote: We recommend using @vue/test-utils for testing components in applications.
The guide includes mount()-based examples interacting with a rendered component.
Components and DOM can be tested using @vue/test-utils.
